title: ExceptionalProEtaleRealization
statement: Realize the pro-etale quotient modules of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image] in the same explicit finite scalar coordinates as [def-pur-adic-etale-realization]. This is an additive exact equivalence. Its comparison with intrinsic finite realization is uniquely fixed on all scalar-unit sections. Derive it by exact localization. The strict coefficient-coordinate functor commutes with ordinary evaluation as an equality of functors. Identify every normalized derived evaluation package with exact derived evaluation by its factorization square on all complexes. Compose these maps and the actual coordinate-equivalence counit to define the direct and inverse coordinate/evaluation identifications.
